params.body:
`actions/checkout` and `actions/setup-node` from v4 to v7 in `ci.yml`.

## What changed between v4 and v7
- v5: both actions run on Node 24 (needs runner 2.327.1 or later; GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-latest` is).
- checkout v6: persisted credentials go to a separate file under `$RUNNER_TEMP` instead of `.git/config`. Nothing in this workflow pushes or reads them.
- checkout v7: refuses to check out a fork's pull request under `pull_request_target` and `workflow_run`. This workflow runs on `push` and `pull_request` only.
- setup-node v5 to v7: automatic caching when `package.json` names a `packageManager`, later limited to npm; ESM; the dummy `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` export is gone. Elixir's workflow does not use setup-node; only checkout changes here.

## Checks
- This pull request's own CI run is the test.
params.title: CI: checkout v4 to v7
